# clavis identities create

<p class="cli-lead">Create a machine or workload identity and its first token</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis identities create NAME [flags]
```

</div>

Create a machine identity and print its first token (shown once), or set up keyless OIDC trust.

## Examples

<p class="cli-example-title">Token for a deploy server</p>

```sh
clavis identities create deploy-bot --role Developer --project web-app --identity-env prod
```

<p class="cli-example-title">GitHub Actions, no stored token</p>

```sh
clavis identities create github-actions \
  --oidc github --repo acme/web --branch main --gh-environment production \
  --role Developer --project web-app --identity-env prod
```

<p class="cli-example-title">GitLab CI</p>

```sh
clavis identities create gitlab-ci \
  --oidc gitlab --repo group/project --branch main --audience clavis
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Kubernetes service account</p>

```sh
clavis identities create k8s-deployer \
  --oidc kubernetes --issuer https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local \
  --audience clavis --k8s-namespace apps --k8s-service-account deployer
```

<p class="cli-example-title">AWS IAM role</p>

```sh
clavis identities create aws-ci --aws-account 123456789012 \
  --aws-arn 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-*' \
  --project web-app --identity-env dev
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Google Cloud service account</p>

```sh
clavis identities create gcp-deployer \
  --oidc gcp --gcp-service-account deployer@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Any OIDC issuer</p>

```sh
clavis identities create ci \
  --oidc generic --issuer https://idp.example.com --audience clavis \
  --claim ref=refs/heads/main
```

## Details

With OIDC, the pipeline exchanges its own token at `POST /api/v1/auth/oidc` (AWS: a signed STS `GetCallerIdentity` request at `/api/v1/auth/aws`) for a short-lived Clavis token.
